contamination_scope: All-four allocation samples, excluded-device process membership, and recorded live-child ownership annotations. This is not continuous monitoring or an independent offline reconstruction of PID ancestry.
data_verification_scope: Environment-captured dataset file hashes compared with frozen protocol; no external dataset/cache paths are opened.
panel_scope: Separate host-resource follow-up; no pooling with original slots.
prediction_inheritance: Exact original sealed predictions with new configuration IDs; no fitting or outcome-dependent update.
prediction_seal_binding: Effective input/output hashes and pre-claim chronology; runner verifies seal but does not store its hash per period.
